notes.title: Dino-Ducks Mayhem now live!
notes.notes:
We’re super excited to announce that the Dino-Ducks Mayhem demo is now officially live! 

The free-to-play demo lets you dive into the chaos solo. Blast through waves of elemental sludge monsters and unlock devastating weapon combos. 

💬 We’d love to hear what you think! Hop into our [url=https://discord.gg/S48MqVSW]Discord[/url] to chat with us directly.

If you enjoy the mayhem, don’t forget to wishlist the game to support the flock!

Thanks so much for playing and helping us shape the game.
